description: Use for "what have I committed to?" or "did my fix work?". Returns the fixes the user chose to do, filtered by status (open, done or all, default all), each with its fix_id and, once newer data is saved, whether the tracked number moved after the fix was marked done. Use the fix_id with mark_fix_done. For new findings use get_today.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

name: get_fix_list
